negative_reviews.author: Amalie
negative_reviews.text: Disappointed. The food quality dropped alot. We came first few months back and the food was nice ,but now is just disappointing. Ordered a ramen and it was so tasteless ,no runny egg, the steak was over cooked even when I specifically asked for medium rare. We literally didnt even finished our food and went to Mr Wang hot pot near, where they do real and tasty ramen for a fracture of the price then maki and ramen..Service was slow, atmosphere was dead. Wont be returning here again.

negative_reviews.author: Amanda Statham
negative_reviews.text: Long wait for food, which then arrived luke warm and we then had to wait for replacement dishes. Skeleton staff meant that service was extremely slow. Waited a very long time to pay. A stressful experience, not likely to return again. A shame as the flavour of the food we had (when warm) was good.
